headings.title: Acknowledgment and certificate form for verified pleadings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes verification of pleadings under this chapter by acknowledgment before an authorized officer and provides statutory form.

headings.title: Satisfaction of chapter verification requirements
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that compliance with subsection 1 satisfies all references to verified documents in this chapter.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.025 governing pleading verification forms and chapter-wide acknowledgment standards.

headings.title: Jurisdictional requirement for custodial orders during deployment
headings.reviewNote: Permits courts to issue custodial responsibility orders under deployment provisions only with jurisdiction under sections 452.700 to 452.930.

headings.title: Preservation of residence during temporary deployment order
headings.reviewNote: Maintains deploying parent residence for jurisdictional purposes during deployment under a temporary custodial order.

headings.title: Preservation of residence under temporary deployment agreement
headings.reviewNote: Maintains deploying parent residence for jurisdictional purposes during deployment under a temporary agreement modifying permanent orders.

headings.title: Preservation of residence under out-of-state temporary order
headings.reviewNote: Maintains deploying parent residence for jurisdictional purposes where another state issued a temporary deployment custodial order.

headings.title: Preservation of temporary emergency jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that deployment jurisdictional provisions do not prevent courts from exercising temporary emergency jurisdiction.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 452.1206 governing jurisdiction and residence preservation during military deployment.

headings.title: Deploying parent notice of pending deployment
headings.reviewNote: Requires deploying parents to notify other parents in a record within seven days of deployment notice, unless prevented by service circumstances.

headings.title: Parent custodial responsibility plan during deployment
headings.reviewNote: Requires each parent to provide a recorded plan for fulfilling custodial responsibilities as soon as reasonably possible after deployment notice.

headings.title: Court notification when address disclosure is prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Restricts delivery of deployment or plan notifications solely to the issuing court when an active order prohibits disclosing address or contact information, and requires the court to forward notices while keeping contact details confidential.

headings.title: Exception for parents sharing same residence
headings.reviewNote: Exempts parents from recorded notification requirements if residing together with actual notice of deployment or plan.

headings.title: Court consideration of compliance efforts in proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Permits courts to consider the reasonableness of parent efforts to comply with deployment notice requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 452.1208 governing deployment notification duties, custodial plans, and confidential disclosure.

headings.title: Duty to notify of address changes during grant
headings.reviewNote: Requires individuals granted custodial responsibility during deployment to provide notice of address changes to parents and relevant courts.

headings.title: Confidential notification to court under protective order
headings.reviewNote: Restricts delivery of address change notifications solely to the issuing court when an active order prohibits disclosure, and requires the court to keep the mailing address or residence confidential.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1210 governing address change notifications by individuals holding temporary custodial responsibility.

headings.title: Temporary agreements granting custodial responsibility during deployment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes parents to enter temporary agreements granting custodial responsibility during military deployment.

headings.title: Writing and signature requirements for temporary agreements
headings.reviewNote: Requires temporary agreements to be in writing and signed by both parents and any nonparent receiving custodial responsibility.

headings.title: Contents of temporary custodial agreement if feasible
headings.reviewNote: Lists provisions a temporary custodial agreement must include if feasible, including deployment details, caretaking allocations, dispute resolution, contact, and child support acknowledgment.

headings.title: Omission of feasible terms not invalidating agreement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that omitting feasible agreement terms does not invalidate a temporary custodial agreement under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.1214 governing temporary parental custodial agreements during military deployment.

headings.title: Temporary nature and termination of agreement
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that temporary custodial agreements terminate after return and create no independent continuing rights in recipients.

headings.title: Standing of nonparent to enforce agreement
headings.reviewNote: Confers standing on nonparents with caretaking or contact authority to enforce temporary agreements until terminated.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1216 governing temporary duration and nonparent enforcement standing under deployment agreements.

headings.title: Modification of temporary agreement by mutual consent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes parents to modify temporary custodial responsibility agreements by mutual consent.

headings.title: Pre-deployment modification in writing and signed
headings.reviewNote: Requires modifications made before deployment to be in writing and signed by both parents and participating nonparents.

headings.title: Modification during deployment agreed to in record
headings.reviewNote: Requires modifications made during deployment to be agreed to in a record by both parents and participating nonparents.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.1218 governing mutual modifications of temporary custodial agreements before and during deployment.

headings.title: Temporary custody order authority and permanent order restriction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes temporary custody orders during deployment under federal law and prohibits permanent orders without deploying parent consent.

headings.title: Motion regarding custodial responsibility during deployment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes either parent to file a motion for custodial responsibility during deployment in pending or new proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1226 governing judicial authority for temporary custody orders and motions during deployment.

headings.title: Grant of caretaking authority to nonparent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to grant caretaking authority to an adult family member or close individual if in the best interest of the child.

headings.title: Time limitations on caretaking authority to nonparent
headings.reviewNote: Restricts nonparent caretaking time absent other parent consent to time previously awarded or habitually exercised by deploying parent.

headings.title: Grant of decision-making authority to nonparent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to grant specified decision-making authority to a qualified nonparent if deploying parent is unable to exercise it.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.1234 governing judicial grants of caretaking and decision-making authority to nonparents during deployment.

headings.title: Temporary duration and termination of judicial grant
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that judicial grants of custodial responsibility are temporary, terminate after return, and create no continuing rights.

headings.title: Nonparent standing to enforce judicial grant
headings.reviewNote: Confers standing on nonparents granted caretaking, decision-making, or contact authority to enforce judicial grants until terminated.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1238 governing temporary nature and nonparent enforcement standing under court deployment orders.

headings.title: Mandatory designations in temporary custody order
headings.reviewNote: Requires temporary custody orders under deployment provisions to be designated temporary and identify deployment conditions.

headings.title: Specific provisions required in temporary custody orders
headings.reviewNote: Specifies terms to be included in temporary orders if applicable, including allocations, communications, and return contact.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1240 governing mandatory contents and specific provisions in temporary deployment custody orders.

headings.title: Modification or termination of temporary custody order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to modify or terminate temporary grants on motion if consistent with statutory standards and child's best interest.

headings.title: Mandatory termination of limited contact on motion
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to terminate a grant of limited contact upon motion of a deploying parent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1244 governing modification and termination of temporary judicial custodial grants.

headings.title: Termination of temporary agreement by signed agreement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes terminating a temporary custodial agreement after return through a written termination agreement signed by both parents.

headings.title: Effective date of agreement to terminate
headings.reviewNote: Establishes termination date of temporary agreements based on date specified or date signed by both parents.

headings.title: Automatic termination sixty days after return notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that temporary agreements terminate sixty days after deploying parent gives notice of return absent termination agreement.

headings.title: Filing agreement to terminate with court
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing agreements to terminate with the court if the temporary agreement was previously filed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.1246 governing termination procedures and timelines for temporary deployment agreements.

headings.title: Automatic termination sixty days after return notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that temporary custody orders terminate sixty days after deploying parent gives notice of return absent filed termination agreement.

headings.title: Law governing proceedings to prevent termination
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a proceeding seeking to prevent termination of a temporary order for custodial responsibility is governed by state law other than sections 452.1200 to 452.1258.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.1252 governing automatic sixty-day termination of temporary deployment custody orders and state law governing proceedings to prevent termination.

headings.title: Application of supreme court and court rules
headings.reviewNote: Provides that rules of the supreme court and applicable court rules govern all proceedings under sections 452.300 to 452.415.

headings.title: Entitlement of dissolution and separation proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required title style for dissolution of marriage, legal separation, and invalidity proceedings.

headings.title: Denomination of initial and responsive pleadings
headings.reviewNote: Designates initial pleading as petition and responsive pleading as answer in original proceedings under sections 452.300 to 452.415.

headings.title: Denomination of petitioner and respondent parties
headings.reviewNote: Designates parties filing initial pleadings as petitioners and responsive parties as respondents, retaining designations in later proceedings.

headings.title: County venue and transfer of original proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes venue in petitioner or respondent county of residence and provides standards for transferring proceedings.

headings.title: Inclusion of decrees within judgment definition
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that judgment includes decree in proceedings pursuant to sections 452.300 to 452.415.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 452.300 governing procedural rules, pleading captions, party designations, and venue standards.

headings.title: Required findings for judgment of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Specifies mandatory findings of residency, waiting period, irretrievable breakdown, and custody or support provisions for dissolution judgments.

headings.title: Required findings for judgment of legal separation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies mandatory findings of residency, waiting period, preservability of marriage, and support provisions for legal separation.

headings.title: Pregnancy status not barring dissolution judgment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that pregnancy status shall not prevent the court from entering a judgment of dissolution of marriage or legal separation.

headings.title: Social Security number disclosure in judgments
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of last four digits of Social Security numbers in judgments and retention of full numbers under section 509.520.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.305 governing grounds and findings for dissolution and legal separation judgments.

headings.title: Verified pleadings and irretrievable breakdown allegations
headings.reviewNote: Requires verification of petitions and motions, and specifies required breakdown allegations for dissolution and legal separation.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of dissolution or separation petition
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth required information in petitions, including residence, marriage date, children, pregnancy status, and relief sought.

headings.title: Immediate child jurisdiction and prohibition on removal
headings.reviewNote: Subjects children immediately to court jurisdiction upon petition filing and prohibits unauthorized removal from jurisdiction or custodian.

headings.title: Possession of child not creating custody preference
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that actual possession of a child at filing does not create a preference in judicial custody determinations.

headings.title: Service and mandatory contents of verified answer
headings.reviewNote: Specifies thirty-day verified answer requirement and mandatory contents to avoid interlocutory default judgment.

headings.title: Abolition of prior defenses to divorce
headings.reviewNote: Abolishes previously existing defenses to divorce and legal separation, including condonation, connivance, collusion, recrimination, insanity, and lapse of time.

headings.title: Retention of full Social Security numbers
headings.reviewNote: Requires full Social Security numbers of parties and children and birthdates to be provided pursuant to section 509.520.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of proposed parenting plan
headings.reviewNote: Specifies detailed requirements for proposed parenting plans, including custody schedules, decision-making rights, and expenses.

headings.title: Temporary parenting plan order on differing proposals
headings.reviewNote: Directs entry of a temporary parenting plan order when parties differ or fail to file proposed plans.

headings.title: Supreme court parenting plan guidelines availability
headings.reviewNote: Requires supreme court parenting plan guidelines to be maintained and made available on the state courts administrator website.

headings.title: Parenting plans for adult children not required
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that parenting plans are not required for children over age eighteen unless agreed to or ordered by the court.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 11 subsection headings for 452.310 governing petition requirements, jurisdiction, answers, and proposed parenting plans.

headings.title: Employer details and Social Security digits in petitions
headings.reviewNote: Requires last four digits of Social Security numbers and current employer details in petitions and motions for support or modification.

headings.title: Employer details and Social Security digits in responses
headings.reviewNote: Requires respondent employer name, address, and last four digits of Social Security number in responsive pleadings.

headings.title: Social Security digits in decrees and orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires last four digits of Social Security numbers of parties to be included in decrees and support orders.

headings.title: Retention of full Social Security numbers
headings.reviewNote: Requires full Social Security numbers of parties and children to be retained pursuant to section 509.520.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.312 governing Social Security number and employer disclosures in family law proceedings.

headings.title: Motion for temporary maintenance or child support
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes either party to move for temporary maintenance or temporary child support supported by affidavit.

headings.title: Motion for temporary restraining order or injunction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes motion for temporary restraining order or injunction regarding property disposition, harassment, family home, and support.

headings.title: Finding of irreparable injury for restraining order
headings.reviewNote: Restricts issuance of restraining orders to cases where evidence shows irreparable injury would result before answering time elapses.

headings.title: Filing timeline for answer to temporary motion
headings.reviewNote: Specifies ten-day deadline or restraining order deadline for filing an answer after service of notice of motion.

headings.title: Issuance of temporary injunction and support order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes temporary injunctions and orders for temporary maintenance or support consistent with sections 452.335 and 452.340.

headings.title: Effect, modification, and termination of temporary orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides that temporary orders do not prejudice subsequent rights, may be modified on affidavit, and terminate upon final judgment.

headings.title: Mandatory temporary child support upon paternity presumption
headings.reviewNote: Requires temporary child support order pending final determination when clear and convincing evidence establishes paternity presumption.

headings.title: Retroactivity of modified or vacated temporary order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes orders modifying or vacating temporary orders to be retroactive to the date of original temporary order entry.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsection headings for 452.315 governing temporary orders, restraining orders, injunctions, and support awards.

headings.title: Finding of breakdown when admitted or undenied
headings.reviewNote: Directs court finding and order of dissolution or dismissal when irretrievable breakdown is stated under oath and not denied.

headings.title: Contested breakdown findings and counseling continuance
headings.reviewNote: Specifies factual proofs required when irretrievable breakdown is denied and authorizes continuance for reconciliation counseling.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.320 governing judicial findings of irretrievable breakdown and counseling procedures.

headings.title: Authority to enter written separation agreement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes parties to enter written separation agreements containing provisions for maintenance, property disposition, custody, and support.

headings.title: Binding effect of separation agreement terms
headings.reviewNote: Makes economic terms of separation agreement binding on court unless found unconscionable, excluding custody and child support terms.

headings.title: Court orders upon finding of unconscionability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to request a revised agreement or enter independent property and support orders if agreement is unconscionable.

headings.title: Incorporation of nonunconscionable terms into decree
headings.reviewNote: Requires setting forth nonunconscionable terms in decree unless agreement provides otherwise, and notes required child support inclusion.

headings.title: Enforcement remedies and contempt for decree violation
headings.reviewNote: Makes terms set forth in decree enforceable by all judgment remedies and punishable by contempt for willful violations.

headings.title: Limitation on modification of decree terms
headings.reviewNote: Allows decree to preclude or limit modification of terms other than child support, custody, or visitation if agreement provides.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 452.325 governing separation agreements, conscionability standards, decree incorporation, and modification limits.

headings.title: Disposition of nonmarital property and marital property division
headings.reviewNote: Requires setting apart nonmarital property and dividing marital property and debts justly after considering statutory factors.

headings.title: Definition and exclusions from marital property
headings.reviewNote: Defines marital property acquired subsequent to marriage and lists specific statutory exceptions including gifts and inheritances.

headings.title: Presumption of marital property and rebuttal
headings.reviewNote: Establishes presumption that property acquired during marriage is marital property regardless of titling, rebuttable by statutory exception.

headings.title: Commingling not converting nonmarital property
headings.reviewNote: Provides that nonmarital property shall not become marital property solely because it may have become commingled with marital property.

headings.title: Finality of property division and QDRO modification
headings.reviewNote: Makes marital property distribution orders final and nonmodifiable, except that qualified domestic relations orders may be modified to establish, maintain, or conform QDRO status; source footnote notes word 'the' does not appear in original rolls.

headings.title: Filing decree affecting real estate with recorder of deeds
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court clerk to file a certified copy of any court decree affecting title to real estate for record with the recorder of deeds where the real estate is situated.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 452.330 governing classification, division, commingling, finality and QDRO modification, and real estate decree recording; source footnote notes word 'the' does not appear in original rolls.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria for maintenance orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes maintenance order only upon finding spouse lacks sufficient property and is unable to support self through appropriate employment.

headings.title: Factors for determining maintenance amount and duration
headings.reviewNote: Specifies relevant factors for determining just maintenance amount and duration, including financial resources and marriage length.

headings.title: Modifiability and duration terms in maintenance order
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintenance orders to state whether modifiable and authorizes fixed terms and modifications based on changed circumstances.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.335 governing spousal maintenance eligibility, factor determinations, and modification terms.

headings.title: Factors for child support orders and retroactivity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes child support orders and retroactive awards based on financial, health, custody, and child care factors.

headings.title: Abatement of support during voluntary custody relinquishment
headings.reviewNote: Provides for whole or partial child support abatement when physical custody is voluntarily relinquished for over thirty consecutive days.

headings.title: Events terminating parental child support obligation
headings.reviewNote: Lists statutory events terminating child support, including death, marriage, active duty, self-support, and age thresholds.

headings.title: Extension of support for incapacitated unmarried child
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to extend support beyond age eighteen for physically or mentally incapacitated, insolvent, and unmarried child.

headings.title: Extension of support for secondary or higher education
headings.reviewNote: Extends child support up to age twenty-one for children enrolled in and completing secondary, vocational, or higher education programs.

headings.title: Waiver of federal and state tax dependency exemption
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to consider ordering waiver of tax dependency exemption for higher education child when financially appropriate.

headings.title: Remedies and support abatement for custody denial
headings.reviewNote: Declares meaningful parent contact policy and authorizes support abatement, custody transfer, expenses, and fees for custody denial.

headings.title: Supreme court child support calculation guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Requires supreme court rules establishing descriptive numeric criteria, joint physical custody credits, and quadrennial guideline reviews.

headings.title: Rebuttable presumption of child support guideline amount
headings.reviewNote: Establishes rebuttable presumption that guideline calculation is correct and requires written findings detailing specific deviation factors.

headings.title: Guidelines application to retroactive support and state debt
headings.reviewNote: Requires use of support guidelines for retroactive third-party support determinations and family support division state debt calculations.

headings.title: Adjustment for joint physical custody equal parenting time
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes up to fifty percent child support adjustment below basic schedule for joint physical custody with substantially equal time.

headings.title: Procedures and affidavits for terminating support obligation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies procedural mechanisms and affidavits for terminating child support upon reaching age twenty-one or emancipation.

headings.title: Judgment terminating support without court appearance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court entry of judgment terminating child support without court appearance and promulgation of uniform affidavit forms.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 13 subsection headings for 452.340 governing child support awards, educational extensions, guideline presumptions, and termination procedures.

headings.title: Request and execution of current support affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes support obligors to request and requires support recipients to execute affidavits attesting that payments are current.

headings.title: Remedies and penalties for affidavit noncompliance or falsehood
headings.reviewNote: Provides cause of action for refusal to execute support affidavit and classifies executing a false affidavit as a misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.341 governing affidavits attesting to current child and spousal support payments.

headings.title: Discretionary bond for support or property division
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to require obligor to give security bond ensuring payment of support installments and property division compliance.

headings.title: Filing and clerk approval of security bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing bond with circuit clerk and permits entry before clerk upon court approval of security.

headings.title: Judgment and execution upon bond default
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to enter judgment against obligors upon bond default and authorizes execution or other enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.344 governing security bonds for child support payments and property division orders.

headings.title: Definition of IV-D support case
headings.reviewNote: Defines IV-D case for support payment and withholding provisions under sections 452.345 to 452.350.

headings.title: Order directing payment to clerk or payment center
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court on its own motion, and requires it on either party's motion, to order maintenance or support payments to the circuit clerk or family support payment center as trustee, subject to division notice.

headings.title: Automated child support system recordkeeping duties
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit clerk to maintain automated system records of support payment amounts, due dates, and party contact details.

headings.title: Duty of parties to report address changes
headings.reviewNote: Requires affected parties to inform circuit clerk or payment center of address changes or conditions affecting administration.

headings.title: Delinquency notice and withholding advice for pre-1994 orders
headings.reviewNote: Establishes clerk delinquency notification procedures and income withholding advice for unmodified pre-1994 support orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 452.345 governing trustee payment collection, automated child support recordkeeping, and delinquency notices.

headings.title: Withholding notice provisions in pre-1994 support orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires income withholding delinquency provisions and additional fifty percent arrearage withholding notices in pre-1994 support orders.

headings.title: Mandatory immediate income withholding in support orders
headings.reviewNote: Mandates immediate income withholding on effective dates of support orders unless good cause or written alternative agreement is shown.

headings.title: Execution and filing of voluntary income assignment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes obligated parties to execute voluntary income assignments at any time when withholding has not commenced.

headings.title: Clerk withholding notice to employer and contest hearing
headings.reviewNote: Directs circuit clerk to send certified withholding notice to employers, specifies contest grounds, and sets hearing deadlines.

headings.title: Employer administrative fee for withholding processing
headings.reviewNote: Permits employers to charge obligors a monthly processing fee not exceeding six dollars for wage withholding.

headings.title: Employer notification of obligor employment termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires employers to notify court in writing upon termination of obligor employment with new employer information.

headings.title: Transmission timeline, multi-case combination, and employer liability
headings.reviewNote: Requires remittance within seven business days, authorizes combined payments, and provides contempt liability for noncompliance.

headings.title: Definition of employer including state subdivisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines employer for withholding purposes to include the state of Missouri and its political subdivisions.

headings.title: Employer retaliation prohibition and penalty fine
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits employer discharge, discipline, or refusal to hire based on a withholding notice and authorizes civil contempt proceedings, reinstatement or hiring orders, and fines up to five hundred dollars.

headings.title: Judicial amendment of wage withholding order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to amend income withholding orders on party motion for good cause shown with employer notice.

headings.title: Judicial termination of wage withholding order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court termination of withholding for good cause shown, excluding sole reason of paid arrearages.

headings.title: Priority and proration of multiple withholding processes
headings.reviewNote: Establishes priority over other legal process and sets pro rata distribution rules when withholdings exceed legal limits.

headings.title: Application of withholding remedy to pre-1986 orders
headings.reviewNote: Applies income withholding remedies to pre-August 1986 support orders upon prior notice from circuit clerk.

headings.title: Administrative amendment or termination by division director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes family support division director to administratively amend or terminate withholding in IV-D cases.

headings.title: Definition of periodic income for withholding
headings.reviewNote: Defines income for withholding purposes to include periodic payments from wages, pensions, workers' compensation, and interest.

headings.title: Use of federal standard employer withholding notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires court use of federally promulgated standard employer income withholding notice formats.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 16 subsection headings for 452.350 governing income withholding orders, employer duties, delinquency procedures, and administrative amendments.

headings.title: Discretionary award of attorney fees and costs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to order party to pay reasonable costs and attorney fees after considering financial resources and conduct.

headings.title: Mandatory fees for child support noncompliance without good cause
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court, if requested and for good cause shown, to order an obligor who failed without good cause to pay child support to pay reasonable suit costs and legal services fees.

headings.title: Definitions of obligor and obligee
headings.reviewNote: Defines obligor and obligee for purposes of attorney fees and suit costs determinations in support proceedings.

headings.title: Definition of good cause for nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Defines good cause for child support nonpayment as substantial inability to pay not purposely maintained.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.355 governing attorney fee awards, litigation costs, and support enforcement sanctions.

headings.title: Finality of dissolution judgment and appeal effect
headings.reviewNote: Establishes finality of dissolution judgments and permits remarriage pending appeal if breakdown finding is unchallenged.

headings.title: Finality of marital property distribution provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that judgments distributing marital property constitute final judgments not subject to modification.

headings.title: Conversion of legal separation to dissolution judgment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court on motion to convert legal separation judgment to dissolution of marriage after ninety days.

headings.title: Setting aside judgment of legal separation
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to set aside a judgment of legal separation upon joint motion of both parties.

headings.title: Clerk notice of judgment to social services
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit clerk to notify department of social services of entries of legal separation or dissolution judgments.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsection headings for 452.360 governing judgment finality, separation conversions, set-asides, and department notice.

headings.title: Changed circumstances standard for modifying support or maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Requires substantial and continuing changed circumstances to modify support or maintenance, with twenty percent guideline prima facie standard.

headings.title: Application of statutory criteria upon meeting burden
headings.reviewNote: Requires determination of modified child support in conformity with section 452.340 criteria after burden of proof is met.

headings.title: Termination of statutory maintenance on death or remarriage
headings.reviewNote: Terminates future statutory maintenance upon death of either party or recipient remarriage unless decree or agreement provides otherwise.

headings.title: Termination of child support upon child emancipation
headings.reviewNote: Terminates support on emancipation and obligates recipient to notify payer or face liability for overpayments.

headings.title: State party joinder when support rights assigned
headings.reviewNote: Requires naming state of Missouri as party and serving division director when modifying support assigned under TANF.

headings.title: Continuing jurisdiction and out-of-state service for modification
headings.reviewNote: Establishes continuing personal jurisdiction, requires address updates, and authorizes out-of-state service for modification motions.

headings.title: Severance of custody issues in IV-D modification
headings.reviewNote: Directs severance upon request of custody or visitation issues raised in response to division child support modification motions.

headings.title: Modification of IV-D support orders without changed circumstances
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court in a IV-D case filed by the family support division to modify a support order in accordance with supreme court rule 88.01 guidelines without showing substantial and continuing changed circumstances.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsection headings for 452.370 governing modification standards for support and maintenance, jurisdiction, and termination events.

headings.title: Declining modification jurisdiction for inconvenient forum
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to decline jurisdiction in modification proceedings upon finding forum clearly inconvenient based on statutory factors.

headings.title: Inconvenient forum finding on court or party motion
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes inconvenient forum findings on the court's own motion or upon motion of either party.

headings.title: Change of venue to more appropriate court
headings.reviewNote: Directs transfer of venue and transmittal of records to appropriate county court accepting jurisdiction.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.371 governing inconvenient forum declinations and venue transfers in modification proceedings.

headings.title: Mandatory educational sessions on child custody or visitation
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to order parties in custody or visitation proceedings to attend educational sessions pursuant to section 452.605.

headings.title: Discretionary alternative dispute resolution program orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court in custody or visitation cases to order alternative dispute resolution under supreme court rule absent good cause (including uncontested cases or domestic violence findings) or to set a hearing.

headings.title: Cost allocation and limitations on alternative dispute resolution
headings.reviewNote: Allocates program costs and restricts dispute resolution from being binding, used for contempt, child support, or unagreed modifications.

headings.title: Supreme court rule authorizing circuit dispute resolution programs
headings.reviewNote: Directs supreme court to promulgate rules allowing judicial circuits to establish alternative dispute resolution programs for custody.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.372 governing mandatory educational sessions and alternative dispute resolution in custody cases.

headings.title: Automatic stay of paternity proceeding upon rape charge
headings.reviewNote: Requires automatic stay of paternity proceedings involving putative father charged with rape conceiving child until criminal disposition.

headings.title: Denial of visitation not used against mother
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits using denial of visitation against mother in subsequent custody proceedings when putative father is charged with rape.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.374 governing automatic paternity stays and visitation protections during rape prosecutions.

headings.title: Definitions of legal, physical, and third-party custody
headings.reviewNote: Defines custody terms including joint legal custody, joint physical custody, and third-party custody for this chapter.

headings.title: Best interests standard, parenting time presumption, and factors
headings.reviewNote: Establishes rebuttable presumption for equal parenting time and specifies eight statutory best interest factors.

headings.title: Custody and unsupervised visitation bars for listed offenses
headings.reviewNote: Bars awarding custody or unsupervised visitation to a parent if the parent or a household member was found or pled guilty to listed child-victim offenses, and grants court discretion for other chapter 566 or 568 offenses.

headings.title: Public policy favoring frequent contact and temporary plans
headings.reviewNote: Declares state policy favoring meaningful parent contact and encourages courts to enter temporary parenting plans early in proceedings.

headings.title: Custody arrangements and third-party placement order of consideration
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth custodial arrangements court must consider, including joint custody, sole custody, and third-party placement criteria.

headings.title: Written findings required when arrangement rejected or contested
headings.reviewNote: Requires detailed written findings of fact when custody is contested or when court rejects a proposed arrangement.

headings.title: Remedies and fees for refusing information exchange
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate compliance orders and payment of the prevailing party's costs, including reasonable attorney fees and court costs, when a parent refuses to exchange child information.

headings.title: Prohibition of custody preference by age, sex, or finances
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits custody preferences based on age, sex, or financial status of parents or age or sex of child.

headings.title: Mandatory specific written parenting plan in judgment
headings.reviewNote: Requires every custody judgment to include a specific written parenting plan setting forth statutory arrangement terms.

headings.title: Mandatory notice of contempt and family access motion
headings.reviewNote: Requires court orders to include statutory notice regarding remedies for noncompliance and pro se family access motions.

headings.title: Prohibition of default plans and interim order restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits local standardized parenting plans and requires notice and hearing before entering interim custody provisions.

headings.title: Parental access to medical, dental, and school records
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees both parents access to child medical and educational records, subject to domestic violence confidentiality orders.

headings.title: Remedies for unlawful denial of records access
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate compliance orders and payment of all costs including attorney fees and court costs when an individual or institution denies child records access without good cause.

headings.title: Joint custody award not precluding child support
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that awards of joint custody do not preclude child support awards under section 452.340.

headings.title: Specific protective findings required upon domestic violence finding
headings.reviewNote: Requires specific factual findings demonstrating that ordered custody arrangements protect domestic violence victims from further harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 15 subsection headings for 452.375 governing child custody definitions, best interest factors, felony bars, and parenting plans.

headings.title: School progress reports for noncustodial or joint parents
headings.reviewNote: Entitles noncustodial and joint custody parents to student deficiency slips and report cards upon request and administrative fee.

headings.title: Annual school district administrative fee for records
headings.reviewNote: Directs school districts to set annual administrative fees estimated to cover copying and mailing costs for student reports.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.376 governing parental access to school progress reports and district administrative fees.

headings.title: Definition of relocation as ninety-day residence change
headings.reviewNote: Defines relocation as changing principal residence for ninety days or more, excluding temporary absences.

headings.title: Advance written notice requirements for proposed relocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires sixty days advance certified mail notice of proposed child relocation detailing address, dates, reasons, and proposals.

headings.title: Exemption for address confidentiality program participants
headings.reviewNote: Permits address confidentiality program participants to omit specific destination addresses and submit them under seal for in camera review.

headings.title: Continuing duty to update relocation information
headings.reviewNote: Imposes continuing obligation to provide changes in or additions to relocation details as soon as known.

headings.title: Protective orders in exceptional circumstances for safety
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes sealing addresses, waiving notice, or entering remedial orders where disclosure risks adult or child health or safety.

headings.title: Consequences of failure to provide relocation notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to consider notice failure as modification factor, grounds for child return, and basis for fee awards.

headings.title: Agreed revised custody schedule without hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to order agreed revised parenting plans and visitation schedules upon signed affidavits without a hearing.

headings.title: Motion and counter-affidavit procedures to prevent relocation
headings.reviewNote: Allows relocation after sixty days unless parent files motion within thirty days, and sets response and counter-affidavit rules.

headings.title: Third-party custodian action for revised schedule
headings.reviewNote: Allows nonparent legal custodians or visitation holders to seek revised schedules without power to prevent relocation.

headings.title: Burden of proof on party seeking relocation
headings.reviewNote: Places burden of proof on relocating party to show proposed move is in good faith and in child's best interest.

headings.title: Contact orders and transportation cost allocation upon relocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires court permitting relocation to order nonrelocating party contact and allocate travel costs and child support.

headings.title: Mandatory statutory relocation notice language in orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of specific statutory notice warning parties of sixty-day notice duties and litigation consequences.

headings.title: In camera review of confidential participant addresses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes in camera submission under seal of address confidentiality program participant destinations upon objection.

headings.title: Relocation violations deemed changed circumstances and contempt
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to treat relocation violations as changed circumstances under section 452.410 and exercise contempt powers.

headings.title: Fee award protection for good faith objections
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits assessing costs and attorney fees against parties objecting in good faith to child principal residence relocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 15 subsection headings for 452.377 governing child residence relocation notice, objections, burdens of proof, and orders.

headings.title: Motion and hearing for temporary custody order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes motions for temporary custody supported by affidavit, grantable after hearing or on affidavits absent objection.

headings.title: Vacation of temporary order upon case dismissal
headings.reviewNote: Vacates temporary custody orders upon dismissal of marital proceedings unless a party moves to continue as custody case.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.380 governing temporary custody motions, hearings, and effect of dissolution dismissal.

headings.title: Investigator consultations and professional diagnosis referrals
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes investigator to consult knowledgeable individuals, refer child for diagnosis, and obtain expert records.

headings.title: Pre-hearing disclosure of report and underlying file

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.390 governing custodial investigations, expert consultations, and pre-hearing disclosures.

headings.title: Priority setting for custody proceeding hearings
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that child custody proceedings receive priority in scheduling for court hearings.

headings.title: Nonjury determination and exclusion of public
headings.reviewNote: Requires judge determination without jury and authorizes excluding general public if hearing would harm child's interests.

headings.title: Sealing of custody interview and investigative records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to seal records of interviews, investigations, reports, or testimony to protect child welfare.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.395 governing priority hearing settings, closed proceedings, and sealing records.

headings.title: Parent visitation rights, domestic violence, and felony bars
headings.reviewNote: Entitles noncustodial parents to reasonable visitation unless endangering the child, bars visitation for listed child-victim offenses, requires domestic violence consideration, and requires protective findings if requested by a party.

headings.title: Modification of visitation rights and unsupervised contact bars
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes visitation modification under best interests, bars unsupervised visits for specified offenses, and permits supervised visits.

headings.title: Mandatory compliance, contempt, and pro se access motions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates order compliance and authorizes aggrieved persons to file contempt or simplified pro se family access motions.

headings.title: Summons issuance, personal service, and mandatory warning notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires summons issuance within five days, expedited personal service, and statutory boldface warning notice.

headings.title: Notice of alternative dispute resolution availability
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerk to provide dispute resolution information and authorizes court scheduling within fourteen days of service.

headings.title: Judicial remedies and sanctions for access violations
headings.reviewNote: Requires the court to order a remedy for unexcused custody or visitation noncompliance, which may include compensatory time, counseling, fines up to five hundred dollars, compliance bonds, and counseling costs.

headings.title: Parenting plan violations as factor in modifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to consider unexcused parenting plan violations when evaluating parent willingness to allow frequent contact.

headings.title: Assessment of reasonable expenses, fees, and contempt
headings.reviewNote: Directs assessment of expenses and attorney fees against parties unreasonably denying visitation, and permits contempt.

headings.title: Sixty-day disposition timeline for family access motions
headings.reviewNote: Requires final disposition of family access motions within sixty days of service unless waived or best interests dictate.

headings.title: Non-independent action status for enforcement motions
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that family access motions are not independent civil actions from original underlying custody judgments.

headings.title: Appointment and fees of guardian ad litem
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointment of licensed attorney guardian ad litem for child and entry of fee judgment.

headings.title: Home study to assist in best interests

headings.title: Judicial consultation with child regarding wishes

headings.title: Termination of grandparent visitation upon adoption

headings.title: Award of attorney fees to prevailing party

headings.reviewNote: Permits either party to terminate ordered mediation at any time following completion of third session.

headings.title: Payment of mediation costs by requesting grandparent
headings.reviewNote: Requires grandparent requesting mediation order to pay all costs of the mediation process.

headings.title: County venue where child resides

headings.reviewNote: Prohibits entering final custody modification orders until ninety days after deployment ends, absent written agreement.

headings.reviewNote: Provides that deployment or potential deployment shall not be the sole factor supporting permanent custody modification.

headings.title: Temporary modification order provisions during deployment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes temporary modifications during deployment, leave visitation, contact updates, and expedited hearings.

headings.reviewNote: Requires nondeploying parent to facilitate leave contact, electronic communication, and receive leave schedules.

headings.reviewNote: Requires mutual cooperation on custody and support and prompt delivery of deployment orders within ten days.

headings.reviewNote: Requires appointment of guardian ad litem for child when court declines SCRA stay and proceeds without deployed parent.

headings.title: Service on nondeploying parent whose whereabouts unknown
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service on nondeploying parents whose whereabouts are unknown pursuant to section 506.160.

headings.reviewNote: Prohibits counting time missed due to military duties against parent in determining failure to exercise visitation.

headings.reviewNote: Denominates child absence during deployment as temporary and preserves exclusive jurisdiction under UCCJEA.

headings.reviewNote: Authorizes attorney fees and costs based on failure to accommodate, delay, or failure to provide orders and information.

headings.title: Submission requirements for registering foreign custody determination
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth required documents, letters, certified copies, and party statements to register out-of-state custody determinations.

headings.title: Filing of foreign judgment and registration notice
headings.reviewNote: Directs registering court to file determination as foreign judgment and serve contest notice upon affected persons.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of registration contest notice
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required notice terms including immediate enforceability, twenty-day hearing request deadline, and preclusion consequences.

headings.title: Contest hearing request and statutory defense grounds
headings.reviewNote: Requires hearing request within twenty days and lists exclusive grounds to contest registration including lack of jurisdiction.

headings.title: Confirmation of registration by operation of law
headings.reviewNote: Provides for confirmation of registration as a matter of law absent timely request for contest hearing.

headings.title: Preclusion of further contest following confirmation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that confirmed registration precludes further contest of matters that could have been asserted at registration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 452.810 governing registration procedures, notice requirements, and confirmation of out-of-state orders.

headings.title: Testimony of out-of-state witnesses by deposition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes out-of-state witness and party testimony by deposition or other allowable procedures in custody proceedings.

headings.title: Electronic and audiovisual deposition and testimony
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes testimony and depositions by telephone or audiovisual means and requires interstate court cooperation.

headings.title: Admissibility of documentary evidence transmitted electronically
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits excluding documentary evidence from other states solely on objection based on electronic transmission means.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.820 governing out-of-state witness testimony, electronic depositions, and evidence transmission.

headings.title: In-state request for out-of-state evidence or studies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri courts to request out-of-state courts to take evidence, conduct social studies, and forward certified records.

headings.title: In-state request for out-of-state party appearance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri courts to request out-of-state courts to order parties to appear with or without child, assessing costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.825 governing Missouri court requests for interstate evidence, social studies, and appearances.

headings.title: In-state court hearing upon out-of-state request
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri courts to order hearings or evidence production upon request of out-of-state courts and forward transcripts.

headings.title: Voluntary testimony for use in outside proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Permits persons within Missouri to voluntarily give testimony or statements for use in out-of-state custody proceedings.

headings.title: Court order compelling out-of-state appearance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri courts to order persons to appear in out-of-state custody proceedings with travel expense assurance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.830 governing Missouri court assistance in gathering evidence and ordering appearances for other states.

headings.title: Scope of child custody enforcement provisions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that enforcement provisions apply to child custody determinations and international child abduction return orders.

headings.title: Temporary enforcement order for out-of-state visitation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court lacking modification jurisdiction to issue temporary orders enforcing out-of-state visitation provisions.

headings.title: Duration and transition period for temporary order
headings.reviewNote: Requires temporary orders enforcing out-of-state visitation provisions without a specific schedule to specify an adequate period to obtain an order from the state having jurisdiction.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 452.855 governing scope of UCCJEA enforcement and temporary orders enforcing out-of-state visitation.

headings.title: State remedies available to enforce registered determination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to grant any relief normally available under state law to enforce registered out-of-state custody determinations.

headings.title: Mandatory recognition and prohibition on modification
headings.reviewNote: Requires courts to recognize and enforce registered determinations while prohibiting modification except under jurisdictional standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.860 governing enforcement relief and modification prohibitions for registered custody orders.

headings.title: Verification and attached orders for enforcement petition
headings.reviewNote: Requires verification of enforcement petitions and attachment of certified copies of orders and registration confirmations.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of enforcement petition
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required allegations in enforcement petitions including jurisdictional basis, modifications, related cases, and relief.

headings.title: Registration date and place statement in petition
headings.reviewNote: Requires petition to state date and place of registration if child custody determination has been registered and confirmed.

headings.title: Order directing respondent appearance and child safety
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to issue an order commanding respondent to appear with or without child and ensure safety.

headings.title: Hearing setting on next judicial day
headings.reviewNote: Requires hearing on enforcement petition on next judicial day following service of process unless impossible.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of hearing order and defenses
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of hearing order advising respondent of child delivery, fees, and statutory defense grounds.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 452.870 governing verification, contents, appearance orders, and expedited hearings for enforcement petitions.

headings.title: Immediate child delivery order and statutory defenses
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to order immediate child delivery to petitioner unless respondent establishes specified jurisdictional or notice defenses.

headings.title: Mandatory fee awards and additional relief
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to award fees, costs, and expenses under section 452.890 and authorizes law enforcement assistance.

headings.title: Adverse inference from refusal to testify
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to draw adverse inference from party refusal to testify on grounds of self-incrimination.

headings.title: Inapplicability of marital and parental privileges
headings.reviewNote: Precludes invoking spousal disclosure privilege or spousal and parental immunity in UCCJEA enforcement proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 452.880 governing immediate physical custody orders, fee awards, adverse inferences, and privilege limits.

headings.title: Verified application for warrant to take custody
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes petitioner to file verified application for physical custody warrant if child is likely to suffer imminent harm or removal.

headings.title: Court issuance of custody warrant and hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to issue warrant upon finding imminent harm or removal and sets hearing for next judicial day.

headings.title: Required contents and directives in custody warrant
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statements in custody warrant including factual findings, law enforcement directives, and interim placement.

headings.title: Immediate service of petition, warrant, and order
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate service of enforcement petition, warrant, and order upon respondent after child is taken into custody.

headings.title: Statewide enforceability and authorization of forcible entry
headings.reviewNote: Makes custody warrant enforceable statewide and authorizes law enforcement private property entry or forcible entry if required.

headings.title: Placement conditions ensuring appearance of custodian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to impose placement conditions to ensure court appearance of child and custodian.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 452.885 governing warrants to take physical custody of endangered children and law enforcement entry.

headings.title: Mandatory expense and attorney fee award
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to award prevailing parties necessary expenses, costs, and attorney fees unless clearly inappropriate.

headings.title: Prohibition on assessment of fees against state
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits assessing fees, costs, or expenses against a state except as otherwise provided by law other than sections 452.700 to 452.930.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 452.890 governing mandatory awards of expenses and attorney fees to prevailing parties.

headings.title: Public official actions to locate and return child
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the appropriate public official to take lawful actions to locate a child, obtain return, or enforce a custody determination or Hague Convention obligation under specified grounds.

headings.title: Public official representation of court not parties
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that prosecutors or public officials act exclusively on behalf of the court and do not represent private parties.
